learning_outcomes.text: Study and understand the organization of a parallel computer.
Analyze the pros and cons of architectural choices.
Synthesize the organization of a parallel system.
Understand the problems of the memory hierarchy, cache coherency and memory consistency.
Understand and analyze the topology, the switching scheme and the routing protocols in processor interconnection networks.
Program in the shared address space model using threads and OpenMP.
Program in the message passing model using MPI.
Analyze the performance of a parallel system.

syllabus_topics: The problems of cache coherency and memory consistency
Interconnection networks, topologies, routing, high-performance switching
Distributed shared memory and non-uniform memory access
Programming in the shared address space model (threads, OpenMP)
Programming in the message passing model (MPI)
teaching_methods: Use of computers for the Lab exercises
Course website maintenance with announcements and posting of teaching material (lecture slides and notes)
Announcement of assessment marks via the ecourse platform by UOI
Use of email for communicating with students

assessment_methods.method: Lab exercises (design and development of parallel programs)

assessment_rules: The lab exercises count for 20-30% and the final exam counts for 70-80% of the course grade. The language of evaluation is Greek.
